findings.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
findings.disposition: Sole unique advisory. Its five affected package-path entries are braces, micromatch, fast-glob, @next/eslint-plugin-next, and eslint-config-next; all are the same transitive advisory path.

overall: Full audit reports 5 High affected package paths representing 1 unique advisory, exactly the accepted development-only RA-2026-F12-001 braces@3.0.3 residual. Do not describe the full audit as clean. Production-only audit reports 0 vulnerabilities.
